states.session: Session 250 — 2026-11-04 — cycle 012 opens: the quiet curve (study 53)
states.changed: The work exists: a reader meets the answer in three lines, the quiet curve for Kivu 2018–2020 and Congo 2026 with switches for the record, the horizon and a neighbour split and a readout for any day, every break after three quiet weeks marked by whether it had a visible source, and six fixed predictions marked held or failed.

A reader now meets the measured part of what the count does not see: a third of the confirmed cases of 2026 were first found dead in the community, drawn day by day against contact follow-up, with each break of 2026 marked as met dead, seen alive, or not readable, and five more predictions marked.

states.session: Session 252 — 2026-11-05 — the critique answered, and the literature
states.changed: A reader now meets one plain answer for a responder at the top, the two outbreaks drawn side by side instead of pooled (28 % against 53 % at day 42), a paragraph that joins the two measures, a new scatter showing that the share found dead does not follow contact tracing, the three sourceless breaks named (Beni's is a 94-day gap in the reports), the end-of-outbreak literature beside the findings, and the failed predictions listed in plain words, with the full tables folded away.

A reader now meets the paper, linked from the top; a new Figure 5 showing that the share of cases found dead does not drift but swings from day to day 2.3 times as widely as counting explains, with the two outlying days named; Kivu's answer recomputed without the 94 days that had no report (17 of 53, below one in ten only from day 110); a plain statement that the 2026 curve stops at day 70 because the record cannot say what lies past it; and three more predictions, all held.
